about.title: About
paragraphs: A versatile and detail-oriented Software Engineering student at Western University with a strong foundation in object-oriented programming, cloud technologies, and machine learning.
My experience includes building scalable solutions for [Canada Basketball](#experience) using Computer Vision and AWS, and optimizing data architecture for [Ajinomoto Foods](#experience).
I am passionate about building accessible, inclusive products and solving real-world business problems through data-driven analysis.
